units.rhetorical_move: says the application became prevalent and of common use

original_instantiations: the information age has arrived
the application became prevalent and of common use

units.source_excerpt: The application became prevalent and of common use all over the world.
units.reusable_pattern: Open with two near-synonyms.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not keep only one.

units.rhetorical_move: says the models are simplified and rationalized

original_instantiations: key factors are folded into return and cost
the analysis is called simplified and rationalized under the assumptions

units.source_excerpt: The analysis is simplified and rationalized under our assumptions.
units.reusable_pattern: Defend a simplification with rationalized.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not apologize for the simplification.

units.rhetorical_move: says a fixed regime may be the most effective

original_instantiations: the trinity is introduced
a fixed regime may be the most effective either way

units.source_excerpt: Whether the currency is abandoned or not, a fixed regime may be the most effective.
units.reusable_pattern: Hedge a recommendation with may be.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not drop the may.

units.rhetorical_move: says the industry almost loses all its business

original_instantiations: a logistic model simulates the outlook
the industry almost loses all its on-balance business

units.source_excerpt: In the long run, the industry almost loses all its on-balance business.
units.reusable_pattern: Keep the agreement as printed.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not correct the verb when quoting.

units.rhetorical_move: asks what is the next

original_instantiations: stability and sensitivity are tested
the pivot is what is the next

units.source_excerpt: The stability is tested, and then the question is what is next.
units.reusable_pattern: Pivot with what is the next.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not answer the question in the same sentence.

units.rhetorical_move: thanks the reader for trusting

original_instantiations: the letter addresses a president or prime minister
it opens with thanks for trusting us

units.source_excerpt: Thanks for trusting us.
units.reusable_pattern: Open a policy letter with thanks for trusting.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not open with a demand.

units.rhetorical_move: guesses the reader has a mixed opinion

original_instantiations: the system was built under the contest
the reader is guessed to hold a mixed opinion

units.source_excerpt: We guess maybe you have a mixed opinion about the system.
units.reusable_pattern: Anticipate doubt with we guess maybe.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not assume agreement.

units.rhetorical_move: says the team feels obliged to recommend

original_instantiations: the opinion is mixed
the team feels obliged to recommend the optimal strategies

units.source_excerpt: We feel obliged to recommend the optimal strategies.
units.reusable_pattern: Justify advice with feel obliged.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not present the advice as optional.

units.rhetorical_move: says the finding reminds the authors of safety
units.function: turn a result into a warning

original_instantiations: one nation collects the biggest extra gain
the individual's benefit may decline, which reminds the authors of safety

units.source_excerpt: The finding reminds us of paying more attention to safety.
units.reusable_pattern: Turn a result into a warning with reminds us of.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not leave the finding without the warning.

units.rhetorical_move: says the risk is manageable
units.function: bind the advice to the risk

original_instantiations: a floating rate brings unsustainable inflation risk
a fixed rate keeps the risk manageable

units.source_excerpt: A fixed rate keeps the inflation risk manageable.
units.reusable_pattern: Call a risk manageable only with the remedy stated.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not drop the remedy.

units.rhetorical_move: says legal support is as important as technical support

original_instantiations: a global node would detect crimes and ease tax
statute backing matters every bit as much as engineering backing

units.source_excerpt: Legal support is as important as technical support.
units.reusable_pattern: Pair two supports with as important as.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not rank one above the other.

units.rhetorical_move: says the zero-sum game will no longer be reasonable

original_instantiations: exchanges will develop on an unprecedented scale
the old zero-sum view will no longer be reasonable

units.source_excerpt: The zero-sum game will no longer be reasonable.
units.reusable_pattern: Retire an old view with no longer reasonable.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not attack the holders of the view.

units.rhetorical_move: says the assumptions may differ slightly

original_instantiations: the model rests on assumptions
they may differ slightly from the reader's circumstances

units.source_excerpt: Our assumptions may differ slightly from your circumstances.
units.reusable_pattern: Hand a strategy back with may differ slightly.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim the model fits every nation.

units.rhetorical_move: hopes the system will be the ideal blueprint

original_instantiations: the suggestions are hoped to be useful
the system is called the ideal blueprint for future development

units.source_excerpt: We hope the system will be the ideal blueprint for future development.
units.reusable_pattern: Close a letter with we hope and ideal blueprint.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim the blueprint is adopted.

units.rhetorical_move: opens with a quotation and a double comma

original_instantiations: a named founder is quoted
the attribution carries a double comma

units.source_excerpt: The section opens with a quotation whose attribution carries a double comma.
units.reusable_pattern: Keep the double comma.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not correct the punctuation when quoting.

units.rhetorical_move: says people are fed up with a controlled currency

original_instantiations: the existing system fails demand
citizens have grown weary of money a state directs

units.source_excerpt: People are fed up with a currency controlled by a government.
units.reusable_pattern: Name discontent with fed up with.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not soften the phrase.

units.rhetorical_move: says enthusiasm evolved from the private to the official

original_instantiations: one country shows the private turn
enthusiasm then evolved from the private to the official

units.source_excerpt: Enthusiasm evolved from the private to the official.
units.reusable_pattern: Trace a shift with evolved from, to.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim the shift is complete.

units.rhetorical_move: numbers the tasks

original_instantiations: five tasks are numbered
the last extends the analysis to long-term effects

units.source_excerpt: The tasks are numbered, and the last extends the analysis to the long term.
units.reusable_pattern: Number the tasks and end on the longest horizon.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not merge the tasks.

units.rhetorical_move: says each assumption is justified and consistent

original_instantiations: the assumptions simplify the problem
every premise is defended and agrees with the plain reality

units.source_excerpt: Each assumption is justified and consistent with the basic fact.
units.reusable_pattern: Defend an assumption list with justified and consistent.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not leave an assumption bare.

units.rhetorical_move: says that is to say the number is limited

original_instantiations: the code node count is fixed in advance
that is to say the number is limited

units.source_excerpt: That is to say, the number of units is limited.
units.reusable_pattern: Restate a premise with that is to say.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not skip the restatement.

units.rhetorical_move: says a public organization is necessary to lead confidence

original_instantiations: currency is called a social convention first and foremost
a public organization is necessary to lead confidence

units.source_excerpt: A public organization is necessary to lead public confidence.
units.reusable_pattern: Repeat a necessity rather than arguing it once.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not drop the repetition.

units.rhetorical_move: says the market is fully open and elements flow freely

original_instantiations: the environment is fully open
goods and funds move without a barrier

units.source_excerpt: The market environment is fully open and the elements are free to flow.
units.reusable_pattern: State openness in two clauses.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not add a barrier.

units.rhetorical_move: says there must be deflation

original_instantiations: the total is fixed while need keeps increasing
there must finally be deflation

units.source_excerpt: Finally, there must be deflation in the system.
units.reusable_pattern: Draw a consequence with there must be.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not hedge this one.

units.rhetorical_move: says it can be seen that value depends on three things

original_instantiations: two equations are combined
it can be seen that value depends on three named things

units.source_excerpt: It can be seen that the value depends on three things only.
units.reusable_pattern: Read an equation with it can be seen that.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not add a fourth dependence.

units.rhetorical_move: says stability is conducive to stability

original_instantiations: the result matches the actual environment
maintaining value stability is conducive to system stability

units.source_excerpt: Maintaining value stability is conducive to system stability.
units.reusable_pattern: Close a derivation with conducive to.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim the stability is guaranteed.

units.rhetorical_move: says the convenience will promote faster flows

original_instantiations: international liquidation grows more convenient
capital flows are promoted to move faster

units.source_excerpt: The convenience will promote capital flows to move faster.
units.reusable_pattern: Name a mechanism with will promote.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim the flows are already faster.

units.rhetorical_move: says the rate will reach a desirable balanced level

original_instantiations: a rise in the rate makes output fall faster
the rate eventually reaches a desirable balanced level

units.source_excerpt: Eventually the rate will reach a desirable balanced level.
units.reusable_pattern: Close a chain with eventually and desirable.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim the level is optimal.

units.rhetorical_move: repeats that the outcome is desirable

original_instantiations: excess capital flows abroad
the outcome is called desirable twice

units.source_excerpt: The outcome is desirable, and the sentence says so twice.
units.reusable_pattern: Keep a repeated sentence.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not delete the repetition when quoting.

units.rhetorical_move: says as we all know the three aims cannot be completed together

original_instantiations: three aims are named
as we all know they cannot be completed at the same time

units.source_excerpt: As we all know, the three aims cannot be completed at the same time.
units.reusable_pattern: Borrow authority with as we all know.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not prove the claim in the same sentence.

units.rhetorical_move: says the impact is close to invalid

original_instantiations: policy, trade and regulation are considered
their impact is called close to invalid

units.source_excerpt: Their impact is close to invalid.
units.reusable_pattern: Belittle a lever with close to invalid.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not say the lever does nothing.

units.rhetorical_move: says the difference triggered thinking about regulation

original_instantiations: three features mark the biggest difference
the difference triggered thinking about regulation

units.source_excerpt: This difference has triggered our thinking about regulation.
units.reusable_pattern: Mark a turn with triggered our thinking.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not start the regulation before the turn.

units.rhetorical_move: says the innovation must not become a cradle of crime

original_instantiations: the current system will no longer apply
the framework must keep the innovation from becoming a cradle of crime

units.source_excerpt: The innovation must not become a cradle of crime.
units.reusable_pattern: Name a danger with cradle of.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not soften the image.

units.rhetorical_move: calls the top node a God node

original_instantiations: everyone becomes a node
the top node is called a God node

units.source_excerpt: The system will have a God node above the others.
units.reusable_pattern: Keep the coined name.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not rename it when quoting.

units.rhetorical_move: says tax evasion will be easier to detect

original_instantiations: every ledger joins one shared web
evasion becomes easier to detect

units.source_excerpt: Tax evasion will be easier to detect.
units.reusable_pattern: Name a gain with easier to.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim evasion becomes impossible.

units.rhetorical_move: says assets will be difficult to escape supervision

original_instantiations: the framework and the laws shape a transparent world
assets and data will be difficult to escape supervision

units.source_excerpt: Assets and data will be difficult to escape supervision.
units.reusable_pattern: Close a section with difficult to escape.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim escape is impossible.

units.rhetorical_move: says the growth rate will drop to zero

original_instantiations: the figure and the formulation agree
the growth rate drops to zero and the bank becomes an intermediary

units.source_excerpt: From the figure, the growth rate will drop to zero.
units.reusable_pattern: Read a figure with from the figure.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not state the result before the figure.

units.rhetorical_move: says it is worth noting that the personal benefit is smallest

original_instantiations: the national level gains the largest marginal benefit
notably the household tier collects the least extra gain

units.source_excerpt: It is worth noting that the personal level gains the smallest marginal benefit.
units.reusable_pattern: Flag an exception with it is worth noting that.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not bury the exception.

units.rhetorical_move: says the local benefit is negligible

original_instantiations: the local effect is the average of individual effects
the marginal benefit to the local is negligible

units.source_excerpt: The marginal benefit to the local is negligible, so security matters more.
units.reusable_pattern: Redirect concern with negligible.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not keep analyzing the local benefit.

units.rhetorical_move: says the view is of great inspiration

original_instantiations: a named professor's view is called pessimistic
it is still of great inspiration

units.source_excerpt: The view is pessimistic, but it is of great inspiration.
units.reusable_pattern: Credit a source with of great inspiration.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not adopt the pessimism.

units.rhetorical_move: says the confrontation will be reduced

original_instantiations: a common identity rests on the technical framework
relations develop toward integration and confrontation is reduced

units.source_excerpt: The confrontation between countries will be reduced.
units.reusable_pattern: Name a direction with will be reduced.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim confrontation ends.

units.rhetorical_move: says the results will not have large fluctuations

original_instantiations: no particular dataset is relied on
adding or removing data leaves no large fluctuations

units.source_excerpt: Adding or removing data leaves no large fluctuations.
units.reusable_pattern: Define stability by the absence of large fluctuations.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim the results never change.

units.rhetorical_move: says the expression is more accurate when the factor increases

original_instantiations: the weights are admitted to be subjective
the expression grows more accurate as the factor increases

units.source_excerpt: The expression is more accurate when the factor is increased.
units.reusable_pattern: Report a test with more accurate when.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not hide the subjectivity.

units.rhetorical_move: says the model is robust

original_instantiations: stability and sensitivity were both examined
the model is called robust

units.source_excerpt: Based on the analysis above, the model is robust.
units.reusable_pattern: Close a test with based on the analysis above.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not add a new test in the close.

units.rhetorical_move: says the methods are scientific

original_instantiations: two named methods approximate the parameters
the methods are called scientific

units.source_excerpt: We apply scientific methods in approximating the parameters.
units.reusable_pattern: Claim a method with scientific.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not name a method without the claim.

units.rhetorical_move: says the classification is rough

original_instantiations: countries are split by size
the classification is called rough

units.source_excerpt: We have a rough classification of country types.
units.reusable_pattern: Admit coarseness with rough.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not defend the classification.

units.rhetorical_move: says the simplifications may leave some errors

original_instantiations: assumptions simplify reality
the simplifications may leave some errors

units.source_excerpt: These simplifications may leave some errors.
units.reusable_pattern: Admit a cost with may leave.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim the errors are small.

units.rhetorical_move: says some models lack data to test

original_instantiations: certain constructions stay pure reasoning with no measurements
they lack data to test

units.source_excerpt: Some models are only theoretical and lack data to test.
units.reusable_pattern: Name a gap with lack of data to test.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not imply the models were tested.

units.rhetorical_move: numbers sources in brackets

original_instantiations: each source opens with a bracketed number
the heading is a single digit

units.source_excerpt: Sources open with a bracketed number under a numbered heading.
units.reusable_pattern: Keep the bracketed numbering.
prohibited_generalizations: The citation list belongs to this paper and does not transfer.
